errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks are at 64, 128, 256, 512, 768 — these are not evenly spaced at intervals of 64. The intervals are 64, 128, 256, 256.
The y-axis range goes up to approximately 0.756, not 0.754. The peak at dimension 512 is approximately 0.755-0.756.

errors.text_span: 继续上升至256时达到0.754，随后在512维度处保持0.754的峰值
errors.evidence: The figure shows that the value at 256 is approximately 0.754, and the peak at 512 is higher (approximately 0.755-0.756). The description incorrectly states both points have the same value of 0.754, when 512 is clearly the higher peak.
The reference description indicates the value at dimension 128 is approximately 0.748-0.749, which is roughly consistent, but the image shows it closer to 0.749, so this is acceptable.
